summary: Iteration 31 - SMS Notification Opt-in Toggle Feature Testing. All 9 backend tests passed (100%). All 7 frontend tests passed (100%). Fixed bug in helpers.py where sms_notifications field was missing from user_to_response function.
critical_code_review_comments: BulkGate SMS credentials (BULKGATE_APP_ID and BULKGATE_APP_TOKEN) are empty in backend/.env - SMS sending will fail until credentials are provided
context_for_next_testing_agent: SMS notification toggle feature fully implemented and tested. Backend: POST /api/auth/register accepts sms_notifications, PUT /api/users/profile updates it, GET /api/auth/me returns it. Frontend: Toggle visible in registration step 5 (personal details) and profile edit mode under phone field. Toggle text: 'Chci dostávat notifikační SMS'. Orange=ON, Gray=OFF. BulkGate SMS credentials pending from user.
